scripts.setup-db: pnpm -F graphql-api exec wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command 'SELECT 1' && pnpm -F database push-dev
scripts.dev: pnpm run setup-db && pnpm run setup-graphql-codegen && pnpm -r --parallel '/^dev:?.*/'
scripts.deploy: BASE_URL=https://tock.run/ pnpm -F web build && pnpm -F graphql-api run deploy
